doc.title: Charles Calello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 21, 2025

title: Sandy Linzer's lyric for A Lover's Concerto
summary: They discuss the title missing from the lyric and Calello's praise for lyricist Sandy Linzer.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: It’s curious, it’s one of the few – there’s a very short list of pop tunes that have titles that are never said in the lyrics.
Did they have that – that was their title at that point?

Yeah. And Sandy – Sandy Linzer wrote the lyric and in my opinion is really, really, really a brilliant lyric writer. He’s written a lot of hits, all different types of hits. And he’s written pop hits all the way up until the Backstreet Boys. So when you have somebody who is that prolific as a kid and has a sensitivity, if you read the story, the story is – it doesn’t sound like it was written by a guy that had that kind of emotion.
But he went on to write many, many brilliant songs.
